### What to do next (the 3 commands you pasted)

Run these in order:

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

**What each does (practically):**
1) **aub_autopilot --select-best**: runs module experiments and updates “best” selection according to your registry scoring rules.  
2) **system_autopilot**: runs the broader system-level candidate set (`system_candidates.yaml`).  
3) **aub_next_fix**: generates a concrete “next fixes” report at `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` (useful for targeted stability/MDD improvements).
